subject: Commercial structure for private deployment: support credits vs usage anchoring
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj@medicore.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medicore.io>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask: Private deployment pricing & support options

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Medicore is excited about Redwood’s VPC option but we need clarity on commercial structure before we proceed to procurement. Two areas we need help with:

1) Platform fee amortization: we run multi-year budgets and prefer smoothing vs big upfront platform fees. Can you show a 36-month amortization and a consumption-only alternative?
2) Support credits vs committed SRE retainer: for our pilot (6 months) we want a mixture of on-call retainer and credits for implementation work. How do you typically package this and what discounts apply?

Attached is a very rough SOW draft — it lists expected milestones. Can you provide a commercial sketch by EOD Friday (Oct 5)?

Thanks,
Raj
Director, Cloud Ops — Medicore Health

Attachment: medicore_sow_draft.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodai.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@medicore.io>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medicore.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: Private deployment pricing & support options

Raj —

Appreciate the SOW — we'll get you a compact commercial sketch. High level thoughts:

- Two pricing paths: (A) Amortized platform fee + lower monthly ops retainer, (B) Lower (or zero) platform fee + higher per-token/usage rate and implementation credits charged as one-off.
- For a 36-month amortization we can spread the platform fee evenly or include a declining schedule (higher in year 1). Both reduce procurement sticker shock.
- Pilot (6 months) option: we typically offer a pilot credit pool (pre-funded implementation credits) plus a reduced on-call retainer at 50% for pilots in exchange for a 12-month follow-on commitment.

I'll loop in Marissa (commercial) and David (finance) to draft two scorable options with numbers. Raj — any target ARR or internal budget band you can share? That will help us size the anchor.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Head of Sales, Enterprise — Redwood Inference

Attachment: platform_fee_breakdown.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 95KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodai.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Commercial sketch inputs for Medicore — two options

Eve / team —

Draft commercial construct below (numbers are illustrative; will tighten after finance check):

Option A — Amortized platform fee + retainer
- Platform fee (36m): $720k total -> $20k/mo amortized (flat)
- Implementation credit pool: $75k (one-time) for pilot professional services; unused credits roll into year 1 ops at 50% value for 90 days
- On-call SRE retainer (pilot): $6k/mo (50% pilot discount), then $12k/mo thereafter
- Support SLA: 8x5 ticketing + 24/7 on-call escalation included in retainer hours; additional overage at time-and-materials
- Discounting: we can offer a 12% commercial discount if Medicore commits to 24 months post-pilot and a min committed GPU capacity (TBD)

Option B — Consumption-first (lower platform fee)
- Platform fee (36m): $180k total -> $5k/mo amortized
- Per-token/embedding rates increased ~30% over hosted list price to reflect private infra costs
- Implementation credits: $40k; on-call retainer optional at $14k/mo
- Discounting: volume tiers at 6/12/18 months hitting usage thresholds; pilot credits only at 30% discount

Key negotiation levers to offer: amortization schedule (flat vs front-loaded), pilot credit roll-forward, and a trial SLA waiver for pilot.

Please confirm if we should model a blended variant (75/25 amortized/consumption) and whether to include a cap on excess overage.

-Marissa
Sr. Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Raj Patel <raj@medicore.io>

Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@medicore.io>
Date: 2026-10-03T14:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial structure for private deployment: support credits vs usage anchoring

Evelyn / Marissa —

Thanks for the clear options. A few clarifications from procurement and finance: 

- Medicore prefers a blended amortization: 60% amortized platform fee (36m), 40% consumption to preserve budget flexibility. Can you model that?
- On implementation credits: we need credits to be usable across pilot and first 90 days of production; can you extend roll-forward to 120 days?
- On the discounting: the 12% is attractive but any way to get a firm commitment to that discount at signature if we hit a 24-month anchor? Our GC asks for a commercial win condition spelled out in the MSA.

Also — quick ask: can you share a sample SOW line itemization for the pilot (2-week onboarding, infra validation, tooling handoff, 2 workshops)? That will help our CISO evaluate the security scoping.

Appreciate it,
Raj

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Modeling blended amortization and expanded credit roll-forward

Team —

Quick finance check and recommendation for reply to Medicore:

1) Blended model (60/40) is doable. Proposed numbers (36m):
   - Total platform fee: $600k (60% amortized -> $10k/mo amortized contribution)
   - Consumption buffer: modeled as a committed consumption floor with a reconciliation at quarter end; suggested floor $30k/qtr to avoid bill shock.
2) Implementation credits: extend roll-forward to 120 days for pilot credits only; any credits beyond pilot move to professional services T&M at a 50% value credit for 120 days.
3) Discounting: we can commit to a 12% commercial discount at signature conditioned on a 24-month anchor and a signed SOW within 90 days. Legal wants ‘win condition’ language like: "Discount applies if customer signs a 24-month commitment within 90 days of MSA signature AND maintains a minimum committed GPU baseline for months 1–6."

If that sounds good, suggest Eve sends a short commercial bullet email back to Raj + Lisa with the numbers and asks for a quick call Thursday to finalize.

-David
VP Finance — Redwood Inference
